description: Pieces of a running quick action's output, as the agent posts them to POST /api/agents/actions/output (agent 1.23+) while the action runs, for an action whose output is shown. The platform relays each to the person who ran the action and never stores it; the final result (POST /api/agents/actions/results) still carries all of it. seq orders the pieces of one run from 0.
